mapper.select: SELECT proj_id AS "id",ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",proj_stat_cd AS "status", ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id}

SELECT r.aply_bgn_ym AS "month",r.part_id AS "partId",p.part_nm AS "partName", r.chg_rsn AS "reason",r.reg_user_id AS "actor" FROM tb_pj_proj_part r LEFT JOIN tb_bs_part p ON p.part_id=r.part_id WHERE r.proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_ym
SELECT close_ym FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE' UNION SELECT pl_ym FROM tb_co_mon_pl WHERE migr_yn='Y'
SELECT max(close_ym) FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE'
SELECT part_id AS "id",part_nm AS "name",use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_bs_part WHERE part_id=#{id} FOR SHARE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_pj_proj_part WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND aply_bgn_ym=#{month}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_pj_proj_chg(proj_id,hist_sn,chg_item_cd,chg_item_nm,bfr_val,aft_val,chg_dt,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES(#{id},#{historySn},'PART','영업 파트',#{before},#{after},CAST(#{now} AS date),#{actor},#{now})
